description: Section of the adobe wall in the roofless room.  In the nicho of the wall  sits a black triangular shaped rock.  In the bottom left corner there is foliage in shadow that  appears to be a Jimson weed trumpet shaped flower.  Viga wooden beams are visible running vertical and horizontally in the upper third of the photograph.
title: White Flower in the Roofless Room, Abiquiu, NM
